paper_title: A Search for Invisible Axion Dark Matter with the Axion Dark Matter Experiment
notes: ADMX Run 1A (2018): haloscope search over 2.66-2.81 ueV (645-680 MHz), first exclusion of DFSZ axion-photon coupling. 90% CL limits shown in Fig. 4 with y-axis in units of 1e-16 GeV^-1; no numerical table provided, so data points are approximate values at roughly the DFSZ coupling level (~4e-16 GeV^-1 at these masses), which the paper states is excluded across 645-676 MHz. Two lineshape assumptions: Maxwellian SHM with rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3 and N-body lineshape with rho=0.63 GeV/cm^3; the primary quoted density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 is recorded. Region 660.16-660.27 MHz vetoed due to RF interference. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.6, 5))
